excerpt: Electroweak measurements performed with data taken at the electron-positron collider LEP at CERN from 1995 to 2000 are reported. The combined data set considered in this report corresponds to a total luminosity of about 3 fb$^{-1}$ collected by the four LEP experiments ALEPH, DELPHI, L3 and OPAL, at
publisher: ALEPH, DELPHI, L3 and OPAL Collaborations and the LEP Electroweak Working Group (submitted to Physics Reports, February 2013)
title: Electroweak Measurements in Electron-Positron Collisions at W-Boson-Pair Energies at LEP
